senses.definition: A large city, the county seat of Cook County, in northeastern Illinois, United States, located on Lake Michigan.
senses.example: I am an American, Chicago born—Chicago, that somber city—and go at things as I have taught myself, free-style, and will make the record in my own way: first to knock, first admitted; sometimes an innocent knock, sometimes a not so innocent.

senses.definition: Any of various forms of the game of pool, designed for gambling.
